sentences.en: Air is a mixture of gases that we cannot see.
sentences.zh: 空气是由我们看不见的气体混合而成的。

sentences.en: Stir the mixture until it foams, then set it aside.
sentences.zh: 搅拌混合物直到起泡，然后放一边。

sentences.en: Put the cooled, cooked apple mixture into the pastry case.
sentences.zh: 把冷却并煮熟的苹果混合物倒入派皮中。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：mix（混合）+ture（状态）→混合
